stories.title: Higher Kinnerton by-election: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash takes 566 of 620 votes cast
stories.summary: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash has won the Higher Kinnerton by-election with 566 votes, 545 more than his nearest rivals. The Welsh Conservative and Reform UK candidates tied for second place on 21 votes each in Thursday’s poll for a seat on Flintshire County Council. Mr Swash, who lives in the village, took 91.3

stories.title: Former charity shop in Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct is becoming a health hub, opening November
stories.summary: A new health centre with consultation rooms for rent to NHS and private practitioners is set to open in Mold’s Daniel Owen Precinct. Hughes Pharmacy is behind the Health and Wellbeing Hub at Unit 4a, which has received capital funding through the Welsh Government’s Transforming Towns programme.
